description: Upload an end thumbnail — an image shown after the video finishes. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable image. Returns the uploaded filename. NOTE: the upload alone is NOT visible in the player — the viewer-facing display requires an `end` CTA on the player config that references this thumbnail. Use this MCP tool to upload the asset; for full setup (CTA wiring), redirect the user to the dashboard end-thumbnail editor.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: panda_add_end_thumbnail
title: Add End Thumbnail
